v1.0.0:
## Highlights
- Initial release of Laterbox, a calm, local-first Android app for saving and organizing links to revisit later.
- Save links with automatic metadata previews, notes, and offline storage.
v1.0.1:
## Highlights
- Introduced the Warm Editorial design system, custom iconography, splash screen, and local link caching.
v1.0.2:
## What's Improved
- Added date grouping and search date-range filters to the Inbox.
- Improved link cards with quick-action menus and direct view controls.
v1.0.3:
## New Features
- Added multi-collection organization so saved links can belong to multiple collections.
- Refined the link detail view and added restore actions for archived links.
v1.0.4:
## Bug Fixes
- Improved reliability when saving and persisting link reminders.
